title: Making Their Mark: Montreal Jewish History Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Tour begins outside of 4129 St-Laurent Blvd. (Museum of Jewish Montreal's "H. Fisher & Fils" storefront location)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Uncover Montreal's Jewish history and heritage on the Making Their Mark tour. Follow an expert guide from the Montreal Jewish Museum through the Plateau neighbourhood, once the epicentre of Jewish life in Montreal, and discover synagogues, schools, hospitals and cultural organizations from the past and present.
